Conclusion: Clang C-only build requires either (a) a working clang-tblgen.exe to generate .inc files from .td, or (b) massive hand-stubbing of all .inc files (~500KB of enum values). Estimated effort: 4-8 hours with clang-tblgen approach, 20+ hours for stubbing. Recommended: build real clang-tblgen from copied source.
